summary: End-to-end verification of Recurring Appeals + Appeal Analytics (click tracking) for Caring Sisters Club. All backend pytest cases (6) and all frontend UI assertions PASSED. Seeded a temp admin+session; injected session_token cookie on the preview host; drove the Admin > Donors view in a real browser. Seeded one segment_emails + paid payment_transactions (appeal_id linked) and verified the Appeal History row rendered Clicks=3, Gifts=1, Raised=$40 via data-testid cells. Opened the Email composer, picked a future date, saw the schedule-repeat-select appear with options 'Does not repeat / Monthly / Quarterly', selected Monthly, clicked segment-schedule-btn (did NOT click segment-send-btn). Verified via API and UI that the scheduled appeal persisted with repeat='monthly' and showed in the Scheduled Appeals table with testid scheduled-repeat='Monthly'. Clicked cancel-scheduled-btn and confirmed the row was removed via API. Also verified /donate?appeal=<uuid> writes sessionStorage key 'csc_appeal' on the public Donate page. Backend tests additionally covered: GET /api/t/appeal/{id} 302->/donate?appeal={id} with clicks increment, unknown id redirect to /donate, POST /api/admin/scheduled-appeals with repeat='weekly' => 400, POST /api/payments/checkout stores appeal_id on pending transaction, and /api/admin/appeals aggregates clicks/gifts/raised. All seed docs and the temp admin user/session were cleaned up afterwards; the 2 real paid donations are intact.

test_results.case: Backend POST /api/admin/scheduled-appeals monthly + GET list + DELETE cancel
Backend /api/payments/checkout stores appeal_id on pending transaction
UI Admin Donors > Appeal History shows Clicks/Gifts/Raised columns and data-testid cells render 3 / 1 / $40 for seeded row
UI Composer: future date reveals schedule-repeat-select with 3 options (Does not repeat / Monthly / Quarterly)
UI segment-schedule-btn creates scheduled appeal (NOT segment-send-btn)
UI Scheduled Appeals table shows 'Next Send' and scheduled-repeat='Monthly'
UI cancel-scheduled-btn removes the scheduled appeal

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDonors.jsx: scheduled-repeat cell renders raw lowercase value ('monthly') capitalized by CSS; works but the data-testid='scheduled-repeat' text content for recurring rows will include trailing ' · N sent' when runs>0. Downstream consumers that assert exact text should trim/startsWith.

backend/server.py:_run_scheduled_appeals - 'repeat weekly' is correctly rejected at POST, but ensure the scheduler ignores any legacy docs with unknown repeat values gracefully (currently _add_months lookup returns None for unknown => treated as one-off, which is OK).

/api/t/appeal/{id} rate-limits clicks per appeal to 3/10min per client; test used a single click so this is fine, but repeated UI clicks from the same IP won't increment -- acceptable but worth documenting.
